mapper.sql: select b.id, b.name, b.description, b.stock_quantity, b.author, b.category_ids, b.shelf_code, b.cover, b.images, b.created_by, b.created_at, b.updated_by, b.updated_at, b.deleted, cu.nick_name as created_by_name, uu.nick_name as updated_by_name from ssk_book b left join sys_user cu on cu.user_id = b.created_by left join sys_user uu on uu.user_id = b.updated_by
mapper.select:
b.deleted = 0

and (
